text: Welcome, {{USER_NAME}}. Your command center is live.

text.text: TestMyPlan helps *{{TEAM_NAME}}* build and run realistic incident response drills — right inside Slack. Configure your org, upload your BCP, set up teams, and trigger your first drill.

fields.text:
:large_purple_circle: *1 · Select your modules*
Choose which IR domains apply — Cybersecurity, Privacy, and more.

:large_blue_circle: *2 · Upload & analyse your BCP*
We extract RTOs, critical services and build your threat landscape.

:large_orange_circle: *3 · Configure response teams*
Assign primary and backup owners for every IR role across all teams.

:large_green_circle: *4 · Trigger your drill*
Send injects now, schedule a window, or fire a surprise exercise.

elements.text: :bulb: Every step is a button — no commands to memorize.
